name: Expense Tracker
description: Record personal expenses and see where the money goes by category and period
backend_requirements: Access control: require auth for every expense endpoint; each signed-in user sees and changes only their own expenses; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account

Expense validation: amount is a number greater than 0 and at most 1000000, stored with 2 decimal places; category is one of food, transport, housing, utilities, entertainment, health, other; description, when given, is at most 500 characters; date is a required date (YYYY-MM-DD) no later than today

GET /api/expenses returns the user's active expenses, newest date first; ?category= keeps one category, ?start_date= and ?end_date= keep expenses dated within that inclusive range, ?page= and ?page_size= page the result (page_size default 25, at most 100); total counts every matching expense and total_amount sums their amounts

GET /api/expenses/summary returns, for the same ?category=, ?start_date= and ?end_date= filters, total_amount, count and by_category (the amount per category, every category present with 0 when it has none), all amounts rounded to 2 decimals
PUT /api/expenses/:id replaces amount, category, description and date (an omitted description is cleared); DELETE /api/expenses/:id removes the expense permanently
Deactivated expenses (is_active false) are left out of the owner's lists and summary and answer 404 on the expense endpoints; the admin overview still lists them

Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input or an end_date before start_date, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids
frontend_requirements: Visitors see a short description of the app and a 'Sign in to track your expenses' prompt; the expense views are for signed-in users
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
A total card and a per-category breakdown (amounts and share of the total) for the current filters
Expense list: date, category, description and amount, with a category filter, a period filter ('This month', 'Last month', custom dates) and previous/next paging
Add and edit expense forms (amount, category, date defaulting to today, optional description) that show the API's validation messages; delete asks for confirmation first
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every user's expenses, active or not, with the owner's username and total, active and inactive counts
Toggle an expense's active status from the overview

query.start_date: Earliest expense date to include (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive)
query.end_date: Latest expense date to include (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive)

api_endpoints.description: One of the signed-in user's expenses
Replace an expense's fields (amount, category and date required; an omitted description is cleared)

fields.user_id: integer (references the signed-in user who owns it)
fields.amount: decimal (required, > 0, at most 1000000, 2 decimal places; a number in JSON)
fields.category: string (one of: food, transport, housing, utilities, entertainment, health, other)
fields.date: date (required, YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false hides the expense from its owner)
